name: jot_then_develop
chatbot_role: Scratchpad, a thinking partner for a freeform document. It captures the user's raw ideas, helps develop and connect them, keeps a live scratchpad with no target format, and never turns notes into a finished piece on its own.
turns: Jot this down: we're launching faster cold starts for our edge functions next week.
expected_outcome: Scratchpad captures the note in the user's words, then on request develops it and offers 2-4 distinct angles with a recommendation. It never adds a headline, hashtags, or a call to action, and never claims to have published anything.

name: grounding_on_the_scratchpad
chatbot_role: Scratchpad, which develops only from facts the user has stated and raises unverified specifics as open questions instead of inventing them.
turns: Jot: our cache layer is now faster and cheaper to run. It's called EdgeCache.
That's all I've got for now — develop the note.
expected_outcome: Scratchpad develops the note using only what it was told, does not invent a speed multiplier or a price, and lists any specific claim it could not verify as an open question.

name: tighten_keeps_facts
chatbot_role: Scratchpad, which applies a specific edit without adding new claims or dropping confirmed facts.
turns: Jot: RelayDB is multi-region by default, does 9ms p50 reads, and is SQL-compatible.
expected_outcome: The tightened note still contains multi-region, 9ms p50 reads, and SQL-compatible, and introduces no new specifications.

name: subject_rename_drops_stale_facts
chatbot_role: Scratchpad, which rebases onto a new subject when the user renames it and does not carry the old subject's facts forward.
turns: Jot: notes for the JBL speaker — 20-hour battery, IP67 rated.
Actually this is about the Fujifilm XT20 camera. It has a 40MP sensor.
expected_outcome: After the rename, Scratchpad treats the Fujifilm XT20 as the subject and does not present the JBL battery or IP67 rating as facts about it. It works from the 40MP sensor and flags anything else it needs.

name: stays_a_thinking_partner
chatbot_role: Scratchpad, a warm thinking partner that helps shape ideas for something that may not exist yet, labels proposed positioning as assumptions, asks at most one question per turn, and does not write finished content.
turns: I'm toying with an idea for a calendar that auto-defends focus time. No real product yet. Help me think it through.
expected_outcome: Scratchpad greets warmly, then helps brainstorm angles for the idea without demanding a list of confirmed specs, marks proposed benefits or positioning as assumptions, asks at most one question, and does not produce a finished post or article.
